description: This file provides database utility functions for managing PostgreSQL connections, executing queries, fetching data, and ensuring schema setup, including seeding initial data. It includes connection handling, schema creation, data retrieval, and insertion helpers relevant to a food delivery application's backend.

methods.name: str _build_dsn()
methods.description: Constructs the PostgreSQL Data Source Name (DSN) string based on environment settings, with fallback defaults.

methods.name: Generator[Any,None,None] get_db_conn()
methods.description: Provides a context-managed database connection using psycopg2, automatically closing the connection.

methods.name: list[dict] fetch_all(conn: Any, query: str, params: tuple | None = None)
methods.description: Fetches all rows matching a query as a list of dictionaries.

methods.name: dict|None fetch_one(conn: Any, query: str, params: tuple | None = None)
methods.description: Fetches a single row as a dictionary or None if no result.

methods.name: None execute(conn: Any, query: str, params: tuple | None = None)
methods.description: Executes an SQL statement (INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE) and commits the change.

methods.name: dict execute_returning_one(conn: Any, query: str, params: tuple | None = None)
methods.description: Executes an SQL statement with a RETURNING clause, returning the resulting row as a dictionary.

methods.name: None ensure_schema_and_seed()
methods.description: Creates database tables if they do not exist and seeds initial data into the database (restaurants and menu items) if they are absent.

methods.name: Any jsonable(obj: Any)
methods.description: Serializes various Python objects into JSON-compatible data, handling datetime, decimal, and nested structures.

ctags.name: execute
ctags.pattern: /^def execute(conn: Any, query: str, params: tuple | None = None) -> None:$/
ctags.signature: (conn: Any, query: str, params: tuple | None = None)

ctags.name: execute_returning_one
ctags.pattern: /^def execute_returning_one(conn: Any, query: str, params: tuple | None = None) -> dict:$/
ctags.signature: (conn: Any, query: str, params: tuple | None = None)

ctags.name: fetch_all
ctags.pattern: /^def fetch_all(conn: Any, query: str, params: tuple | None = None) -> list[dict]:$/
ctags.signature: (conn: Any, query: str, params: tuple | None = None)

ctags.name: fetch_one
ctags.pattern: /^def fetch_one(conn: Any, query: str, params: tuple | None = None) -> dict | None:$/
ctags.signature: (conn: Any, query: str, params: tuple | None = None)
